flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/CPS/form/CPSForm.tsx (TabItem summary, onBeforeTabChange, CPSTabNavigation, useFormAction), pages/CPS/list/CPSList.tsx (mode SUMMARY), hook/useCPSFormData.ts. ocmsadminapi: EligibilityService is only called through the Proceed to CPS button. Other repos: not relevant
note: The summary page exists as a 'Summary' tab inside the CPS form (read-only list of notices with new stage, reason, remark, letter address). Ordering gap: the story puts the summary AFTER the stage validity check, but the Summary tab is gated only by FE validation (required fields), while the server validity check runs only when Proceed to CPS is clicked (which can also be clicked from the Details tab). So the officer can see a summary containing a stage that the server will later reject. The demo remark in stories.json says the 'Chang Processing Summary Page' was demoed on 18 Sept 2024; that date is a claim, not code evidence.
recommendation: Claim with a note: 2 Sesuai, 1 Sebagian (the summary appears before the server validity check).

steps.step: OCMS displays a summary page of the selected notices
steps.detail: TabItem code='summary' label='Summary' (CPSForm.tsx:621-632) renders CPSList in SUMMARY mode, read-only, for all selected notices. Notices deleted from the Details tab also disappear from the summary because they share the same notices state. The Next Page / Previous Page buttons move between tabs (CPSForm.tsx:484-520).

steps.step: The summary shows the new processing stage (plus reason and remark) for each notice
steps.detail: SUMMARY mode shows New Processing Stage, Reason of Change, Remark and Letter Address from noticeFormData, '-' when empty (CPSList.tsx:364-403), next to Current Processing Stage (:211-214). Values appear as codes (not necessarily descriptions); that is cosmetic only.

steps.step: The summary only appears after the new stage is confirmed valid
steps.detail: Moving to the Summary tab only calls onValidateForNavigation, which is the FE validateAll (required fields), with no server call (CPSForm.tsx:578-580, :336-345). The server validity check (POST .../validate) only runs in onConfirmation through the Proceed to CPS button (:90-117), shown in the right slot of every tab (:582-587). So the summary can be viewed for a stage the server later rejects; the 'valid first, then summary' order in the story is not met.
